records.subject: Polyaniline/poly(2-acrylamido-2-methyl-1-propanesulfonic acid)/phytic acid ternary ionic TE hybrid

records.subject: Freestanding EMIM:DCA/PEDOT nanowire composite films
records.object: Thermoelectric performance of the majority of IL/polymer composites
records.quote: Herein, we selected 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanamide (EMIM:DCA) to post-treat freestanding PEDOT nanowire (NW) films and the effects on thermoelectric performance were fully explored.
context_quotes: EMIM:DCA post-treatment simultaneously increases the Seebeck coefficient (87% increment) and electrical conductivity (24% increment) of PEDOT NWs, resulting in an optimal power factor of 83.8 mu W m(-1) K-2 at room temperature.
It demonstrates the first ever-reported free-standing IL/polymer composites and outperforms the majority of all IL/polymer composites.

records.subject: IL-induced dedoping
records.conditions: EMIM:DCA-treated freestanding PEDOT nanowire films; Soret effect is dominant.
records.quote: Herein, we selected 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanamide (EMIM:DCA) to post-treat freestanding PEDOT nanowire (NW) films and the effects on thermoelectric performance were fully explored.
context_quotes: Based on experimental characterizations, we elucidate that IL-induced dedoping and the Soret effect synchronously determine the Seebeck coefficient enhancement, where the Soret effect plays a dominant role, accounting for 79.9% for PEDOT NW films with 80 wt % EMIM:DCA.
modality_evidence: Based on experimental characterizations, we elucidate that IL-induced dedoping and the Soret effect synchronously determine the Seebeck coefficient enhancement, where the Soret effect plays a dominant role, accounting for 79.9% for PEDOT NW films with 80 wt % EMIM:DCA.

records.subject: IL-induced dedoping
records.conditions: EMIM:DCA-treated freestanding PEDOT nanowire films; supported by XPS, UPS and XRD.
records.quote: Herein, we selected 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanamide (EMIM:DCA) to post-treat freestanding PEDOT nanowire (NW) films and the effects on thermoelectric performance were fully explored.
context_quotes: By means of X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS), and X-ray diffraction (XRD), we further confirm that IL-induced dedoping contributes to phase segregation and compact stacking of PEDOT chains, resulting in lowered carrier concentration for the enhanced Seebeck coefficient and facilitating carrier transport for higher electrical conductivity.

record.quote: Herein, we selected 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanamide (EMIM:DCA) to post-treat freestanding PEDOT nanowire (NW) films and the effects on thermoelectric performance were fully explored.
context_quotes: Based on experimental characterizations, we elucidate that IL-induced dedoping and the Soret effect synchronously determine the Seebeck coefficient enhancement, where the Soret effect plays a dominant role, accounting for 79.9% for PEDOT NW films with 80 wt % EMIM:DCA.

By means of X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS), and X-ray diffraction (XRD), we further confirm that IL-induced dedoping contributes to phase segregation and compact stacking of PEDOT chains, resulting in lowered carrier concentration for the enhanced Seebeck coefficient and facilitating carrier transport for higher electrical conductivity.
